meta.name: azure-cost
meta.description: Azure cost management: query costs, forecast spending, optimize to reduce waste. WHEN: "Azure costs", "Azure bill", "cost breakdown", "how much am I spending", "forecast spending", "optimize costs", "reduce spending", "orphaned resources", "rightsize VMs", "cost spike", "reduce storage costs", "AKS cost". DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并优化 Azure 云支出，降低浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为 Azure 账单过高而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Query and optimize Azure cloud spend, reduce waste
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about high Azure bills

howto.what: 装上后,当您询问 Azure 云服务花销时,Claude 会查询历史成本、预测未来开支,并按 Redis、存储等具体服务给出省钱建议。
howto.when: 当您提到“Azure costs”“Azure bill”等关键词,或要求预测支出、优化成本时触发;不用于部署资源、预配等操作。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个月的Azure账单
say.note: Claude 会查询该月的成本明细。

say.text: 预测未来三个月的云支出
say.note: Claude 会调用预测接口给出预估。
Claude 会针对存储服务给出优化建议。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude can query your Azure cost history, forecast future spending, and give service-specific optimization suggestions (e.g., Redis, Storage) to reduce waste.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "Azure costs" or "Azure bill", or ask to forecast spending or optimize costs. Not for deployment, provisioning, or security audits.

say_en.text: Check my Azure bill for this month.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the cost breakdown.

say_en.text: Forecast our cloud spending for the next three months.
say_en.note: Claude will use the forecast API.

say_en.text: How can I reduce storage costs?
say_en.note: Claude will give storage-specific optimization tips.
